newsitem.title: USA: GKN gets 97 pct of Sinter Metals.
newsitem.headline: GKN gets 97 pct of Sinter Metals.

text.p: GKN Plc said Monday that it has completed its cash tender offer for all of the outstanding shares of Sinter Metals Inc Class A common stock and Class B common stock at $37 net per share, receiving about 97 percent of all outstanding common shares of Sinter Metals.
Each Sinter Metals share not tendered will be converted into the right to receive to receive $37 in cash, without interest, under a merger expected to be completed promptly.
Sinter Metals has approximately 10.4 million fully diluted shares outstanding, making the deal worth about $570 million, including the assumption about $184 million of net debt.
